mission_check.capability: Choose and execute attacks across consecutive natural wild encounters with one frozen semantic battle model
mission_check.learned_authority: The frozen battle ranker owned every attack; setup and healing were bounded teacher mechanics, not battle choices
mission_check.transfer_test: No transfer result; later comparisons require disjoint upstream development roots and varied party/opponent contexts
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: One claim-first bounded train source fails to produce durably retained model choices and actual outcomes across natural encounters
mission_check.time_box: One session and one prospectively bound train-root pilot
mission_check.stop_condition: Stop after one root, missing retained choice/outcome, unsafe source/setup, budget or field failure, no useful contrast, model fit, development opening, full run or GitHub publication

interpretation.limitation: Three hashes reflect opponent and PP/level changes under one root; every selected move was the same one-turn knockout against level-32 wild opponents. This does not establish useful alternative-move judgment, root diversity, or superiority to a fixed heuristic.
interpretation.next_decision: Measure actual alternative-move outcomes only from isolated branches of the retained train pre-choice states. If the alternatives are also trivial or timing cannot be matched, stop this source family and seek a better choice-rich train context before fitting or spending development roots.
